description: Defines one-time progression rewards: the ItemSet granted when a specific story/PvE/PvP/arcade/collection milestone is reached, together with the condition type and numeric/name parameters used to test and describe that milestone.

Id.technical: FName key. The PvP result path collects the Id of every row whose condition is PvPRankMatchWinningStreakCount and passes them to GameShop_GrantProgressRewardRows; a full grant sweep collects every row's Id. The grant helper scans ProgressRewardDataTables for each ID, skips missing rows, and is the only route that turns a reward row into an item-set grant.

Id_ItemSet.simple: ItemSet awarded by this reward row.
Id_ItemSet.technical: FName. GameShop_GrantProgressRewardRows resolves this ID in ItemSetDataTables, requires the set's first item to be non-None and not already in stock, checks that the set is unlocked and all reward conditions are reached, then grants the set once with Count=1. UI code finds the reward row by matching Id_ItemSet to an ITM_SET_PROGRESS_REWARD* set to show the reward name and unlock progress.

UnlockConditionsType.simple: Kind of player milestone that unlocks the reward.
UnlockConditionsType.technical: EGameItemUnlockConditionsType (Default=1 through UseKyotoStudentsCount=64 in the reconstructed enum, Invalid=255), default None. GameItem_GetUnlockProgress switches on it to convert save data into one or more (current, required) FIntPoint pairs; every pair must be reached for GameItem_IsProgressRewardReached. It also chooses the unlock-message text and the GetType category used when granting: story=2, PvE risk=6, other PvE=4, anything else=7. PvP win-streak rows are additionally selected by UGameResultWidget::OpenPvPResult.

UnlockConditionsValue.simple: Numeric thresholds/counts for the unlock condition.
UnlockConditionsValue.technical: TArray<float>; thresholds are converted with FMath::CeilToInt (the retail SSE ceil idiom). Index 0 is the required count/level/rank for most types; for rank-threshold conditions index 0 selects the rank tier and index 1 is the required count. Some conditions use pairs such as (rank, count), while others use no numeric values at all and rely only on the type/strings. Exported rows normally contain three floats, with trailing zeroes unused.

UnlockConditionsValueStr.simple: Name parameters (character/stage/mission/rank IDs) for the unlock condition.
UnlockConditionsValueStr.technical: TArray<FName>. Interpreted by type: e.g. StoryMissionClearRank uses index 0 as a demo ID, StoryCharaRelateThreshold uses two character IDs, PvEGrowthCharaLevelThreshold uses a character ID, PvPRankPointMax uses a RankPoint row ID (which points to GlobalThreshold::Min), and arcade-clear types treat every non-None entry as a character ID and emit one (0/1, 1) clear-flag pair each. Index 0 is read unguarded by the arcade reward-info widget. Names are also substituted into ITM_UNLOCK_MESSAGE_* text requests.

notes: The export contains 493 rows. UnlockConditionsType, UnlockConditionsValue, and UnlockConditionsValueStr form one loosely typed condition record; their meaning is defined jointly by the type switch in GameItem_GetUnlockProgress, not by the array indices alone.

Progress pairs use (current, required). A condition is reached when current >= required for every pair. No condition/unknown type becomes the never-passing sentinel (-1, 0), while boolean conditions add (0, 1) until reached and (0, 0) when reached.

Arcade plate reward display specifically filters for ArcadeModeCharacterClear rows whose UnlockConditionsValueStr[0] equals the selected character and whose item set begins with a Plate item; it then shows the set name and OnUnlock/OnLock animation.
Multiple ProgressRewardDataTables shards are supported; grant and UI helpers scan them in order. Only the supplied retail export and partial Content are available.

usages.detail: GameItem_GetUnlockProgress is the shared condition interpreter for progress rewards and shop lineups.
GameItem_IsProgressRewardReached requires every condition pair to be satisfied.
Grants each eligible reward's ItemSet once and classifies the grant by condition type.
Sweeps all progress reward rows for bulk grant checks.
On PvP result, selects win-streak reward rows and appends granted item sets to the result display.
Finds a character's arcade plate reward, shows its item-set name, and plays an unlock/lock animation.
Builds the ITM_UNLOCK_MESSAGE_* text explaining a reward's remaining condition.
